correctness.rationale: The exact identity \(B=-r+\sum_i (s_i+s_{i+1})(s_i+s_{i+1}+t)/2\) has nonnegative local terms for every \(t,s_i\in\{-1,0,1\}\). For even rims, equality identifies the alternating full rim; for odd rims, occupied path components, full-cycle frustration and one-vacancy parity give sharp bounds by total occupancy \(q\). The only exposed sectors are \(q=n+1,n-1,0\) for odd rims, and \(q=n+1,n,0\) for even rims. Equality configurations have multiplicities \(2n,4n,1\) or \(4,2,1\), respectively; the \(n=3\) coincident transition is treated explicitly. Direct exhaustive independent enumeration for rim sizes \(3\le n\le10\) and exact boundary-state contractions for \(3\le n\le70\) corroborate all claimed formulae and degeneracies. These computations are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural all-size zero-field classification of vacancy condensation on a frustrated triangulated wheel, not an arbitrary finite slice. It distinguishes the odd-rim two-vacancy phase of positive width \((n-3)/(2(n-1))\) from the even-rim hub-only vacancy stage, and counts the exact \(6n\) and \(4n+1\) coexistence multiplicities. The local triangle identity and rim path-parity mechanism explain the difference and supply a finite-cluster benchmark for frustration with zero-spin vacancies. No additional theorem or bulk transition is claimed, and the restriction to one parameter is stated.
